failure_modes: Over-engineered persona that increases the mismatch
Long generic answers to short questions
gloss: Conversation with an agent feels wrong when the illusion of a person breaks
invariants: Naturalness depends on knowing the conversation partner
The break appears as a mismatch between expected and actual behavior
mechanism: As a chat agent approaches natural conversation, small inconsistencies (length that does not match how a teammate would answer, no memory of the user, generic advice) break the illusion and feel unsettling. Cookie-cutter filters and system prompts cannot fix it because the deficit is missing knowledge of who is being talked to.
